question: Should OpenClaw accept this Discord-only opt-in source-message subagent progress surface now, or fold it into broader cross-channel subagent liveness and terminal-delivery work?
rationale: The patch is additive and channel-owned, but it creates a new operator-visible Discord config and lifecycle metadata surface that needs maintainer product direction beyond code correctness.

options.title: Accept Discord opt-in after rebase
options.body: Land the default-off Discord progress feature once the dirty branch is refreshed and the existing tests/proof still cover the merge result.

options.title: Fold into generic liveness work
options.body: Hold this PR and require the behavior to be implemented through a broader cross-channel subagent liveness contract before Discord ships a separate surface.

options.title: Defer or close
options.body: Close or pause the PR if maintainers do not want channel-specific subagent progress until the parent lifecycle work settles.

recommendation.title: Accept Discord opt-in after rebase
recommendation.body: Land the default-off Discord progress feature once the dirty branch is refreshed and the existing tests/proof still cover the merge result.
